note: Set A binds values to the correct member types and keeps useful context (channel C3X6, angle L4X4X5/16, plate PL5X3/8, weld 1/4" TYP, HSS tied to Reference Keynote 05, 11 1/2" and 6" tied to Duct Framing Detail 3/C2, 5 1/8" tied to Detail A5), so its claims are more specific and mostly supported. Set B is vaguer (repeated "structural element"/"Duct Framing Detail" entities), duplicates the scale and PL 4 1/2X4 1/2X1/2 claims, and includes clearer misbindings such as C3X6 called a "Beam", PL5X3/8 attributed to "component B" (a detail bubble), L4X4X5/16 called a roof framing member, and invented "offset"/"in" conditions. Set A is not clean either: the 10" dimension is misbound as C3X6 depth, 1/4" TYP is twice called duct-framing thickness/dimension, and the 5/8" and 1 3/8" dimensions get invented "bottom"/"right side" clearance conditions. Both omit some sections present on the sheet (A misses W8X10, W10X12, L3X3X1/4; B misses the 1/4" TYP weld and 5 7/8"/10"/11 1/2"), but A's bindings and conditions are the more faithful overall.
